audit.whatIsWrong: Page reads EVEN 5.5/10; the mirror audit set the Gangplank side to FAV 4/10.
audit.why: Ratings are inverse across the mirror, so an EVEN label here directly contradicts the already-published Gangplank page. His 1000-range kegs versus her 450 Q, plus a cleanse for her only pin, is a real disadvantage.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].side/win[3] and phases[4].side/win[4] read 'Skill' while the mirror flipped both to Gangplank, and the packet level chart also gives him 4-5 and 6.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 is when Remove Scurvy is reliably up to cancel her pin, and level 6 is when Lilting Lullaby (150s at rank 1) meets a 22s cleanse that cures the Drowsy. whys[3] and whys[4] on this page ALREADY describe Gangplank winning those stages — only the enum rows disagreed.
audit.corrected: Both rows flipped to Gangplank in both layers as one atomic group, with matching why text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Remove Scurvy curing the Drowsy from Lilting Lullaby — is only gestured at, and Powder Keg is described as a knock-up.
audit.why: Riot's text: Remove Scurvy 'eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health', 22s at rank 1. Powder Keg spreads attack damage and SLOWS; it has no knock-up and no cooldown, only stored kegs. Lillia's R applies Drowsy before sleep, so a cleanse read on the Drowsy blanks a 150-second ultimate.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy named with its 22s rank-1 cooldown as the cooldown to bait; keg described as a slow with stored charges, not a knock.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings call Trial by Fire a 'crit passive'.
audit.why: Trial by Fire sets the target on fire on a melee strike — it is a burn, not a crit. Crit comes from his items, which is a different timing entirely.
audit.corrected: Named Trial by Fire and described as burn damage stacking on top of the keg chain.

audit.why: Blooming Blows' outer ring is true damage, so his armour stacking does not reduce it — worth stating because it is the reason her chip still lands into a bruiser build. Also confirmed with the mirror: Lillia has NO dash, so every retreat line is written around move-speed stacks.
audit.corrected: True damage written into breakdown.cooldowns; 'no dash' stated in mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Swirlseed's terrain flag is a tooltip-parsing artefact.
audit.why: Riot's description says the seed rolls until it hits a wall or a target; it does not create terrain. The mirror reached the same conclusion and declined to write it.

edits.before: This is where it tilts to him. Your Levels 4-5 burn compounding wants a target who has to walk at you, but Gangplank just stands back and barrels — you eat poke trying to close range, and his W cleanses the E slow that is your whole kite chain. At 6 your Lilting Lullaby is real but awkward: the sleep is delayed and he can W out of the slow setup, so only commit it with a jungler or after baiting his W on cooldown. Dodge pre-placed barrels, never path through a cluster, and don't burn your dash-less Q hops chasing him through a knock-up.
edits.after: This is where it tilts to him. Your Levels 4-5 burn wants a target who has to walk at you, but Gangplank stands back and kegs — you eat poke closing range, and Remove Scurvy cleanses the Swirlseed slow that is your whole pin, every 22 seconds at rank 1. At 6 Lilting Lullaby is real but awkward: the Drowsy is delayed and his W cures it, so commit that 150-second ult only with a jungler or after baiting the citrus. Dodge pre-placed kegs, never path through a cluster, and remember you have no dash — your move-speed stacks are the whole escape.
